description: Load source records and normalized objects before component candidates, then load subcomponent candidates and source links.
Generated rows enter candidate tables first; only reviewed and promoted rows become active components or active subcomponents.
Candidate rows retain source object ids, source record links, content hashes, license, trust tier, and privacy boundary where available.
Subcomponent candidates should link back to a parent object id and, where resolvable, a component candidate id.
Planning emits CSV and SQL only; actual psql execution is a separate operator or worker step.
